text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: REALISM

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the sixteenth century as the European nations vied for power, their monarchies became the main patrons of art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Court artists such as Velasquez painted the ruling families of Europe and had the time and financial backing to break new ground.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Artists such as Velasquez, Chardin, or Van Dyck, for example, began to depict real life rather than fictional scenes, mythical or religious subjects, going beyond the formal portrait to paint events, objects and people that interested them.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: History painting and still life were explored by an increasing number of painters.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Diego Velasquez

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A painter by appointment to the Spanish court, Velasquez painted some of the best known works in the history of painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of his most popular works shows the King Philip, the queen and the Infanta standing in an informal group with various servants in a room in the royal household looking out at the viewer.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Velasquez chose to show the family at home in intimate surroundings, several rooms beyond the room in which they stand visible through a door behind them.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The family look out of the painting as if the viewer has trespassed upon them in their private quarters yet they regard the viewer with a challenging cool assurance.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The use of perspective and light and shade focuses the viewer’s eye on the Infanta.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This painting does not have a literal narrative but neither is it a straight forward family portrait.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Velasquez has taken a psychological approach to his subjects which was unusual at the time.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Velazquez also painted many portraits including one of King Philip on a rearing horse, and a portrait of the Infanta wearing a lacy dress.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The detail of the spectacular red dress, the lace, embroidery and the jewels on it, is painted with thick squeezes of paint which viewed close up seem no more than rapid impressions and the viewer is very conscious of the physical properties of paint on canvas.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Viewed from a distance however the apparently crude application of paint is astoundingly like the fabric it portrays.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Rokeby Venus is one of Velasquez’s best known works.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It shows a reclining nude with her back to the viewer, her face, which stares directly at the viewer, visible in a mirror held in front of her on ribbons by a cherub with red and white feathered wings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This painting, like the one of the royal family, addresses the psychology of looking at paintings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It gives the viewer access to the subject but ensures by the choice of pose, composition and facial expression that the subject is portrayed as being aware that they are being observed.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This ensures that the viewer cannot avoid acknowledging their own subjectivity.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE STILL LIFE

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Artists had begun to explore new subjects and the still life became an important genre of painting which reached its height in sixteenth and seventeenth century Europe.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The still life had many forms, the most common being a table bearing an array of food and drink, a vase of flowers, or an arrangement of objects.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The still life allowed the painter to display skill in the way the various items are painted and can be seen essentially as a close 0up view, in contrast to a painting of a scene or a person.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The skin of a lemon, the shine and reflection on silver ware, the pattern on a pheasant’s feathers, the weave of a rug, the petals of flowers all gave ample opportunity for displays of virtuosity.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A typical food still life might have fruit piled casually on a plate, silver pitchers or goblets, a dead game bird, a candle, knives, glasses, some meat or fish.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The food would usually have been chosen to present an impressive display so that anyone who saw the picture would be impressed by how the owner was able to live.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Zubaran and Chardin were early exponents of the still life.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Zubaran

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A Spanish sixteenth century artist who is known chiefly for his still lifes, Zubaran made several paintings of vegetables such as cabbages and pumpkins.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In one such painting an array of vegetables is shown hanging from a line, tied on by string of varying lengths.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The vegetables are set against a plain background.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Chardin

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Like Zubaran, Chardin usually painted flowers and vegetables and was rigorous in his choice of subject and composition, often making very simple arrangements of one or two items and concentrating on painting them as realistically as possible.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Similarly, paintings of flowers were a signal of wealth and many artists added flowers to combinations of other items.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Later on the Dutch flower painters concentrated on the flowers alone, filling the canvas with vases of exotic mixed floral arrangements.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These were also intended as displays of wealth, for only the richest could afford cut flowers.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Some still life painting depicted only objects, perhaps a rustic plate and cup, a book and a lamp, or richly decorated precious items.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Kalf, a Dutch artist, painted a suit of armour cast onto a chair by a table covered with gold goblets and plates, the metal glows and shines and reflects fire and lamplight.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Kalf’s virtuosity is revealed by a close inspection of the painted shine, made from the tiniest and most carefully applied touches of a range of yellows, whites and ochre.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Whereas most still life paintings have no narrative, the vanitas painting is a form of still life which depicts objects with an allegorical or symbolic significance.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The vanitas might be painted to celebrate a particular person’s interests and achievements through objects alone, or combined with a portrait of the person.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The symbolism in vanitas painting is not always evident and some knowledge is required to interpret them.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Skulls make an obvious and frequent appearance to represent mortality, as do books to represent learning, musical instruments, globes, sextants and telescopes to represent travel and the outside world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: However more obscure and personal items would have been significant only to the subject or commissioner of the painting and those that knew them.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of the best known vanitas paintings is Holbein's The Ambassadors.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Holbein

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: An English artist working during the reign of Elizabeth the first, Holbein, like most artists of the time mostly painted to commission, recording the members of and activities of the royal Court.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He made several distinctive standing portraits of the Queen including one in which she is wearing a white embroidered dress decorated with pearls, one of her father Henry VIII, and many other people, usually between fifty cm and one metre high.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also painted Sir Thomas More.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Ambassadors is a very well known painting which shows two bearded dressed in doublet and hose with cloaks edged with ermine and hats, standing either side of a sideboard and table.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: On the furniture are casually arranges various items, tropes, that represent elements of learning and knowledge which are prerequisite to public life.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Some of these are obvious, like the globe and compasses, the bible, others more obscure to us today.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In the centre of the painting is a curious trompe l’oeil feature.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Invisible to the viewer standing in front of the painting but for a smear like element, viewed from a specified angle a skull can be seen.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is speculated that Holbein merely wanted to display his virtuosity, or that the painting was intended to be hung on a stairway where it would be reliably encountered at the requisite angle.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Elizabethan artists often specialized in miniature painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Miniatures were around ten cm high, often oval shaped very detailed head and shoulders portraits.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They were used like photographs to carry a likeness of a person around.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The miniature had a strategic function too – portraits of possible marriage partners could be conveyed to each party.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This was important since marriages between members of the royal family and the nobility were often arranged between different nationalities for political reasons, and the couple would rarely have met before the marriage.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the Elizabethan period, Europe underwent great political upheavals as the Protestant and Catholic churches vied for power.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Alliances were forged and broken and the borders of modern Europe were drawn.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: By the seventeenth century Europe had entered a phase of prosperity.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Amsterdam was the centre of the trade in goods from overseas and became a very wealth city.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Artists were employed to represent and display the wealth of the new merchant class.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Venice was also a wealthy and powerful centre of trade, and it was painted many times by Canaletto.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Canaletto

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Canaletto is world famous for his scenes of Venice in panoramic format showing the grand canal and its palazzos with water traffic passing, painted in very accurate detail and bathed in a golden sunlight.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Canaletto also spent some time in London and painted the Thames river front, including the Royal Naval College at Greenwich and St Paul’s Cathedral.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Canaletto's painting are among the most frequently stolen in the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The influence of Italian classical sculpture spread and statuary was an essential element in architectural design, interiors and gardens.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There were many popular sculptors.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Canova

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: An Italian classical sculptor who made a work called The Three Graces a two metre high white marble sculpture of three women in flowing robes holding hands dancing in a circle.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This sculpture has been stolen once.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: DUTCH PAINTING

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Dutch seventeenth century painting depicted domestic interiors inhabited by the merchant class.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This was the first time people other than the ruling classes had been able to commission artists because of the new found wealth brought by the import and export business.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Painters such as Van Dyck, Rembrandt and Vermeer were not presenting images of authority and power, they were depicting the calm serenity of the domestic sphere, a feminine world inhabited temporarily by men.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The paintings reproduced the architecture of the time and some artists such as Saenredam made this their subject.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Pieter De Hooch

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: De Hooch painted the life of the Amsterdam merchant class in intimate detail.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He was painting at a time when this newly wealthy class wanted to display its wealth to the world, but women were still largely confined to the home.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Windows were always open with light streaming in to spaces which were otherwise candlelit, and food was plentiful, even fruit (although this was evidently a luxury).

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: De Hooch’s paintings portrayed a range of subjects, for example in one a toddling child reaches up to the mound of apples on a woman’s lap.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The woman is sitting on a stool on the stone flagged floor and there is a door leading into a room with a window in it behind her.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The child is rosy cheeked and blonde.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Another shows a back yard with red bricks laid and plants growing along a wall.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The architecture of the houses, the brickwork, the construction of doors and windows, the flooring and soft furnishings are faithfully reproduced.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Johannes Vermeer

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Vermeer is famous for his painting The Card Players, which shows a group of people sitting round a table at night, the scene lit by lamp and candlelight.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The light glows on the faces of the card players but this is a very dark painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of the men in the painting stares out at the viewer.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Vermeer painted numerous self portraits showing himself both as a young and old man, but like de Hooch he is best known for his paintings of domestic interiors, for example Woman at a Window and another painting of a woman playing the harpsichord.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His interiors usually show a room lit from one side by a window, with a door in an opposite wall.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The furnishings are comfortable, the floor is often black and white stone tiles, and the walls panelled.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: If a man is present he is placed by or looking out of the window.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The woman is often seated, and looking at the viewer or into the room although the woman playing the harpsichord is in profile.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Vermeer wanted to symbolise the different realms inhabited by men and women in the seventeenth century, the outside world and the domestic space.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In Woman at a Window a map hangs on the wall behind the woman, as if to amplify this difference.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Woman with A Pearl Necklace is a very well known portrait of a young woman wearing a simple yellow and blue dress with fabric wrapped round her head and a peal necklace at her throat.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Rembrandt van Rijn

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rembrandt is acknowledged to be one of the greatest artists of all time.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His paintings are celebrated for their treatment of light and for their psychological approach.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He tried to show the personality and mood of the sitter, giving the viewer the opportunity to make an assessment about the kind of person they are looking at.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Rembrandt used light to great effect, not just in the way he used painting to represent it but also in his composition, in how he places figures in relation to light sources.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of Rembrandts best known works is The Night Watch a painting of a group of people sitting in the dark with candlelight.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Another is Girl at a Window which shows a young girl seated at a table looking up to a window through which light is streaming into the very dark interior.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: As with most of Rembrandt’s work, light is the subject of this painting.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Pieter Saenredam

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Saenredam is noted for his church interiors which are generally quite small.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One shows the architecture of the Osterkerk in Amsterdam, with tall stone columns, a floor of black and white squares of marble, and people dwarfed by the height of the building.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The composition is deceptively ordinary, apparently showing an everyday view of an interior, but the treatment of light in the painting is skilfull, producing an effect of great serenity.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The predominantly black and white painting has its focal point in the black diamond shaped board hanging from one of the columns, concentrating the viewer’s eye on the pattern of black and white, vertical lines and perspective planes in the composition.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the seventeenth century Europe saw much political upheaval and many significant events took place.
